scripts.record: node record.mjs nl && node record.mjs en
scripts.render: node prepare.mjs && remotion render remotion/index.jsx demo-nl out/website_demo_long_NL.mp4 --public-dir=raw --crf=18 && remotion render remotion/index.jsx demo-nl-portrait out/website_demo_phone_long_NL.mp4 --public-dir=raw --crf=18 && remotion render remotion/index.jsx demo-en out/website_demo_long_EN.mp4 --public-dir=raw --crf=18 && remotion render remotion/index.jsx demo-en-portrait out/website_demo_phone_long_EN.mp4 --public-dir=raw --crf=18
scripts.render:promo: node prepare.mjs && mkdir -p out/marketing && for v in promo:marketing promo-quiz:marketing_quiz; do for l in en:EN nl:NL; do remotion render remotion/index.jsx ${v%%:*}-${l%%:*} out/marketing/${v#*:}_short_${l#*:}.mp4 --public-dir=raw --crf=18 || exit 1; done; done
scripts.render:lessons: node prepare.mjs && mkdir -p out/lessons && for l in en:EN nl:NL; do remotion render remotion/index.jsx lesson-present-regular-${l%%:*} out/lessons/lesson_present_regular_short_${l#*:}.mp4 --public-dir=raw --crf=18 || exit 1; done
